naive_curve_hazard.correct_route: work on the chi-eigenspace/rank-one Kummer sheaf, or use Stepanov directly, so the conductor is O(|B|)
naive_curve_hazard.firewall: no future certificate may claim B4 closed from a whole-curve genus bound unless the d-dependence is removed
naive_curve_hazard.problem: the genus of the whole d-cover can grow like d*|B|, so the bound may carry a factor depending on d
naive_curve_hazard.tempting_route: use the smooth projective model of y^d=f(x) and Hasse-Weil for the whole curve
naive_curve_hazard.why_bad_for_burgess: d can be as large as P-1, but Burgess needs a constant depending only on fixed r

plain_conclusion: Weil 输入的真正自足剩余继续缩窄。Burgess 完全和中的有理函数 `f=prod(x-a)^{e_a}` 不是 `d` 次幂时，目标不是整条 `y^d=f(x)` 曲线的属数界，因为那会带入角色阶 `d`；正确对象是秩一 Kummer sheaf `L_{chi(f)}` 或等价的 Stepanov 辅助多项式证明。其导子只由分支点数控制，在 2r 矩中 `cond<=2r+2`，所以一旦有秩一 Kummer RH/Stepanov 迹界，就得到阶无关的 `O_r(P^(1/2))`，从而关闭 B4。作者侧完全自足仍未完成；下一唯一硬点是 `SelfContainedRankOneKummerSheafRHTraceBound`，等价初等路线是 `StepanovAuxiliaryPolynomialRankBoundForKummerSums`。行/列命题仍未无条件闭合。

rational_sum_statement.branch_places: B={a in P^1: ord_a(f) not congruent to 0 mod d}
rational_sum_statement.burgess_kernel_size: for the 2r-th Burgess moment, |B|<=2r; infinity is unramified because numerator and denominator have equal degree
rational_sum_statement.character: nonprincipal multiplicative character chi of order d
rational_sum_statement.function: f(x)=prod_a (x-a)^{e_a} from the Burgess complete kernel after collecting signed multiplicities
rational_sum_statement.needed_bound: |sum_x chi(f(x))| <= C_r P^(1/2) with C_r independent of d and P
rational_sum_statement.nonpower_condition: some e_a is not divisible by d, equivalently f is not a d-th power in F_P(x)

导子只由分支点数控制，Burgess 2r 矩中 `cond<=2r+2`，与角色阶 d 无关。
迹公式接口已固定：目标和等于 `H_c^1` 上 Frobenius 迹。
若接受秩一 Kummer sheaf 的 RH/Weil 迹界，则得到所需 `O_r(P^(1/2))`。
